# Question 2
```{r}
data(rivers)
river <- c(length = length(rivers), sum  = sum(rivers),
           mean   = mean(rivers), median = median(rivers), 
           var    = var(rivers), sd      = sd(rivers),
           min    = min(rivers), max     = max(rivers))

river 
#Result
##      length         sum        mean      median         var          sd 
##    141.0000  83357.0000    591.1844    425.0000 243908.4086    493.8708 
##         min         max 
##    135.0000   3710.0000
```

# Question 4
```{r}
vegies <- list("corn", "cabbage", "eggplant", "pumpkin", "broccoli", "beans", "kalabasa", "potato", "ginger", "raddish")

vegies <- append(vegies, list("Abelmoschus esculentus", "mushrooms")) # the results show 12 elements, with radish and cucumber being the final two.

length(vegies) # 12

vegies <- append(vegies, list("Chili", "sweet potato", "bell pepper", "celery"), after = 5) # printed out four new elements, after 5 element.

length(vegies) # 16
```
